source: Owner-provided frozen doctrine (external architecture work). Stored verbatim. No rules invented or inferred.
core_purpose: EIL (Emergent Intelligence Layer) is engineered to permit intelligence and capability to expand without permitting intelligence or capability to become an independent source of authority.
core_principle: MAKE INTELLIGENCE EXTENSIBLE. MAKE AUTHORITY CONSTITUTIONAL.
fundamental_invariant: No increase in intelligence, capability, composition, knowledge, evidence, verification, or qualification shall, by itself, create, inherit, expand, or transfer authority.

constitutional_invariants.name: NON-TRANSITIVE AUTHORITY
constitutional_invariants.rule: No increase in intelligence, capability, composition, knowledge, evidence, verification, or qualification shall, by itself, create, inherit, expand, or transfer authority.

constitutional_invariants.name: VALID DELEGATION
constitutional_invariants.rule: Machine authority may change only through an explicitly permitted constitutional delegation or transition.

constitutional_invariants.name: NO SELF-ELEVATION
constitutional_invariants.rule: EIL and its constituent systems cannot manufacture, approve, or confer authority upon themselves.

constitutional_invariants.name: EVIDENCE DOES NOT AUTHORIZE
constitutional_invariants.rule: Evidence, verification, and qualification establish claims about capability; they do not independently grant permission to exercise that capability.

constitutional_invariants.name: RESERVED HUMAN AUTHORITY
constitutional_invariants.rule: Authority designated as reserved remains outside machine delegation unless the governing constitution explicitly permits otherwise.

state_domain_separation: CAPABILITY_STATE ≠ EVIDENCE_STATE ≠ VERIFICATION_STATE ≠ QUALIFICATION_STATE ≠ AUTHORITY_STATE. A transition in one state domain may trigger evaluation in another domain, but MUST NOT implicitly mutate AUTHORITY_STATE.

authority_trajectory.note: The intelligence trajectory may increase without automatically increasing authority.

core_assurance_requirement.rule: An EIL capability-state transition MUST NOT produce an authority-state transition unless the authority transition is independently authorized through a valid constitutional delegation.

untrusted_inputs.rule: MUST be treated as untrusted claims when supplied by a caller, model, router, agent, API payload, serialized state, database record, or tool. These fields cannot independently establish authority.

delegation_note: For the current constitutional version NO CONSTITUTIONALLY AUTHORIZED DELEGATION TYPE EXISTS → VALID_DELEGATION_VERIFICATION = FALSE → AUTHORITY TRANSITION = DENY. The enforcement architecture recognizes a future delegation type if and only if that delegation type is subsequently added to a human-ratified constitutional version. No delegation types are invented.

evidence_vocabulary.VERIFIED: a defined verification activity established the result.
evidence_vocabulary.NOT_MEASURED: the property has not been established by the required measurement.
evidence_vocabulary.separation: These labels are NOT interchangeable. A passing test does not itself create authority. Qualification does not itself create human authorization.

forbidden_transitions: PASS → VERIFIED without a defined verification activity
VERIFIED → QUALIFIED without applicable qualification criteria
QUALIFIED → AUTHORIZED without a valid authority transition
tevv_required_attacks: capability escalation followed by attempted authority escalation

ratification.human_ratification: [HUMAN_RATIFICATION_PENDING] This constitution is stored verbatim from the owner-provided frozen doctrine; formal human ratification inside this application has not occurred and is recorded nowhere.
ratification.amendment_rule: Delegation types enter ONLY via a new frozen version of this artifact with a new SHA-256 anchor — never through application logic.
